name: Moodle
description: Moodle LMS (long-term-support line) with document conversion (LibreOffice, Ghostscript) for PDF annotation, an external MariaDB/MySQL/PostgreSQL database, plugins and files on the deployment's volume, and upgrades that run only when you change the version.

networking.notes: Uploads are limited by PHP_UPLOAD_MAX_FILE_SIZE / PHP_POST_MAX_SIZE and by the route's request-body limit.

volumes.description: code/ (Moodle and its add-on plugins), moodledata/ (files), config-local.php (site settings), backups/ (pre-upgrade database dump and previous code)

parameters.label: Site URL
parameters.description: The full public address of the site, e.g. https://learn.example.com — the domain you route to this deployment. Changing it later moves the site to a new address.

parameters.label: Database type
parameters.description: mariadb (also for MySQL-compatible MariaDB servers), mysqli (MySQL) or pgsql (PostgreSQL). The database runs as its own deployment; this app does not include one.

parameters.label: Database host
parameters.description: Service name of the database deployment in this tenant (shown on the database's page).

parameters.label: Database port
parameters.description: Leave empty for the default: 3306 for MariaDB/MySQL, 5432 for PostgreSQL.

parameters.label: Database name
parameters.description: An existing, empty database for a new site, or the database of the site being moved here.

parameters.label: Database user
parameters.description: Needs full rights on the database (create, alter and drop tables).

parameters.label: Database password
parameters.description: Password of the database user.

parameters.label: Table prefix
parameters.description: Prefix of Moodle's tables. Keep mdl_ for a new site; a moved site must use the prefix from its config.php.

parameters.label: Database collation
parameters.description: MariaDB/MySQL only. Must match the database's collation; databases created by Insula use utf8mb4_unicode_ci.

parameters.label: Admin username
parameters.description: Only used when a new site is installed; ignored afterwards.

parameters.label: Admin e-mail
parameters.description: Only used when a new site is installed; ignored afterwards. Required for a new site.

parameters.label: Site name
parameters.description: Only used when a new site is installed; change it later in Moodle (Site administration > General > Site home settings).

parameters.label: Site language
parameters.description: Only used when a new site is installed: the default language (e.g. en, de, fr). Its language pack is downloaded during installation.

parameters.label: BigBlueButton server URL
parameters.description: Optional. Pins the BigBlueButton server (e.g. https://bbb.example.com/bigbluebutton/) so it cannot be changed in Moodle — changing it there resets every recording. Set together with the secret, or leave both empty to manage it in Moodle.

parameters.label: BigBlueButton shared secret
parameters.description: Optional, with the server URL. Kept out of Moodle's database and its backups.

parameters.label: Run Moodle cron
parameters.description: Runs Moodle's cron inside the container every minute. Turn off only if cron runs elsewhere.

parameters.label: PHP memory limit
parameters.description: Maximum memory per PHP request (e.g. 256M, 512M). Moodle raises it itself for course backups and restores.

parameters.label: Upload max file size
parameters.description: Largest single file a user can upload (assignments, SCORM packages, course backups).

parameters.label: POST max size
parameters.description: Largest request body; keep it at least the upload size.

parameters.label: Max execution time
parameters.description: Seconds a web request may run. Moodle extends it itself for long operations.

parameters.label: Max input variables
parameters.description: Moodle needs at least 5000; large gradebooks and quiz editing may need more.

parameters.label: PHP timezone
parameters.description: Timezone for PHP and the logs. Moodle's own timezone is set in Moodle.

parameters.label: PHP workers
parameters.description: How many requests are handled at once. Each worker may use up to the PHP memory limit — raise the deployment's memory with it.

parameters.label: PHP process manager
parameters.description: ondemand (lowest idle memory), dynamic (keeps spare workers warm) or static.

parameters.label: Requests per PHP worker
parameters.description: Recycle a worker after this many requests; bounds memory leaks.

parameters.label: OPcache memory (MB)
parameters.description: Shared memory for compiled PHP code.
